    11	/-!
    12	# Fibrewise H1 witnesses on the widened divisor carrier
    13	
    14	The chart-typed fibre theorem in `DivisorThetaFibreData.lean` has two geometric inputs:
    15	
    16	* a certified adaptation stays certified after passing to a residue field, so its fibre
    17	  presentation divisor has the certificate degree;
    18	* subtracting that fibre divisor from a sufficiently positive theta window gives a divisor
    19	  with the required Picard class and vanishing `H1`.
    20	
    21	Neither input depends on a chart typing of the adaptation cover.  This file proves both for
    22	`AffAdaptation`, whose pieces are arbitrary affine opens.  The conclusion is deliberately the
    23	geometric witness itself, rather than a hypothesis about a not-yet-constructed widened Cech
    24	engine: it is directly reusable by any right-exactness or classifier construction on the
    25	widened carrier and introduces no new premise.
    26	
    27	## Main declarations
    28	
    29	* `AffAdaptation.IsCertified.deg_presentationDivisor_pulledEquations` -- the fibre divisor of
    30	  a widened certified adaptation has the certificate degree.
    31	* `AffAdaptation.IsCertified.fibrewise_thetaSub_h1_witness` -- at every residue field, the
    32	  explicit divisor `N(a) - d_p` has the transported theta-minus-family class and vanishing
    33	  `H1` once `a` is in the existing high window.
    34	* `AffAdaptation.IsCertified.exists_chartAdaptation_thetaGluedEval_surjective` -- an auxiliary
    35	  finite chart presentation of the same local equations has surjective high-window evaluation;
    36	  the chart presentation is extracted, not assumed or certified.
    37	-/

    99	private lemma chi_relCurve_of_chi_aff (g : Nat)
   100	    (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : Int))
   101	    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] :
   102	    Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (g : Int) := by
   103	  haveI : IsProper (baseChangeBundle C K).hom := instIsProperSndLeft C K
   104	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (baseChangeBundle C K).hom :=
   105	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionSndLeft C K
   106	  haveI : GeometricallyIrreducible (baseChangeBundle C K).hom :=
   107	    instGeometricallyIrreducibleSndLeft C K
   108	  have h1 : Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K)
   109	      = 1 - (genus (baseChangeBundle C K) : Int) := chi_moduleKSheaf (baseChangeBundle C K)
   110	  have h2 : genus (baseChangeBundle C K) = genus C := genus_baseField C K
   111	  have h3 : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (genus C : Int) := chi_moduleKSheaf C

   115	private lemma picClass_neg_aff {K : Type u} [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}}
   116	    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
   117	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
   118	    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] (D : X.CurveDivisor) :
   119	    Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K (-D) = (Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K D)⁻¹ := by
   120	  have h := Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_add K (-D) D
   121	  rw [neg_add_cancel, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_zero] at h
   122	  exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left h.symm

   126	/-- The divisor cut on a field-valued fibre by a widened certified adaptation has exactly the
   127	certificate degree.  Properness makes the intersections of the affine pieces affine, so the
   128	widened certificate base-change theorem applies without an extra overlap hypothesis. -/
   129	theorem IsCertified.deg_presentationDivisor_pulledEquations
   130	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   131	    [Algebra R K] [IsScalarTower k R K]
   132	    {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
   133	    {A : AffAdaptation D d} {n : Nat} (hc : A.IsCertified n) :
   134	    Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg K (Scheme.presentationDivisor K
   135	      ((A.pulledEquations K hc.projective_colength).presentation)) = (n : Int) := by
   136	  have h := (A.pullback K hc.projective_colength).deg_presentationDivisor
   137	  rwa [(A.isCertified_pullback K D.hasAffineOverlaps_of_isProper hc).finrank_glued] at h
   138	
   139	/-- At every field-valued point of the base, a widened certified family supplies the actual
   140	high-window cohomology witness: `N(a) - d_p` represents the pullback of
   141	`[Theta^a] * [d]^-1` and has vanishing `H1`.  This is the geometric producer needed by the
   142	widened right-exactness/classifier layer; no chart typing of the adaptation cover occurs. -/
   143	theorem IsCertified.fibrewise_thetaSub_h1_witness
   144	    {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
   145	    {A : AffAdaptation D d} {g : Nat} (hc : A.IsCertified g)
   146	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   147	    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
   148	    (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : Int))
   149	    {a : Nat} (ha1 : Subsingleton (relTwistPair C k pi (relThetaCocycle C k pi a)).H1)
   150	    (hMa : windowM_choice pi hpi g ≤ a)
   151	    (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
   152	    ∃ W : (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).CurveDivisor,
   153	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass p.asIdeal.ResidueField W
   154	          = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C R p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
   155	              ((thetaChartDatum C R pi a).cechPicClass * d.picClass⁻¹)
   156	        ∧ Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   157	            ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).divisorSheaf
   158	              p.asIdeal.ResidueField W) 1) := by
   159	  let K := p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   160	  let dp := Scheme.presentationDivisor K
   161	    ((A.pulledEquations K hc.projective_colength).presentation)
   162	  refine ⟨windowTransportDivisor C K pi a - dp, ?_, ?_⟩
   163	  · have e1 : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K dp
   164	        = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C R K) d.picClass := by
   165	      dsimp [dp]
   166	      rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_presentationDivisor,
   167	        Scheme.LocalEquations.presentation_picClass]
   168	      exact A.picClass_pulledEquations K hc.projective_colength
   169	    have e2 : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a)
   170	        = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C R K)
   171	            ((thetaChartDatum C R pi a).cechPicClass) :=
   172	      (picClass_windowTransportDivisor C K pi a).trans
   173	        (cechPicClass_map_thetaChartDatum C R pi a K).symm
   174	    calc Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a - dp)
   175	        = Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a)
   176	            * (Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K dp)⁻¹ := by
   177	          rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_add, picClass_neg_aff]
   178	      _ = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C R K)
   179	            ((thetaChartDatum C R pi a).cechPicClass * d.picClass⁻¹) := by
   180	          rw [e1, e2, map_mul, map_inv]
   181	  · refine subsingleton_h1_windowTransportDivisor_sub C pi hpi K g a
   182	      ha1 hMa hO hchi (chi_relCurve_of_chi_aff C g hchi K) dp ?_
   183	    have hdeg := hc.deg_presentationDivisor_pulledEquations
   184	      (C := C) (R := R) (K := K)
   185	    dsimp [dp] at hdeg ⊢
   186	    rw [hdeg]
   187	    have := Int.natCast_nonneg g
   188	    linarith
   189	
   190	/-- The widened fibre witnesses fire the existing right-exactness engine on an auxiliary finite
   191	chart presentation of the same local-equation system.  Such a presentation exists for every
   192	`d`; it is neither an input nor required to be certified.  Its theta-ideal datum has the
   193	intrinsic class `[Theta^a] * [d]^-1`, so the widened witness supplies exactly the residue-field
   194	divisor and `H1` vanishing that `thetaGluedEval_surjective_of_fibre_witness` consumes.
   195	
   196	This is the chart-free right-exactness bridge at the cover-independent window: the resulting
   197	evaluation has kernel `d.vanishingSubmodule`, hence its window carve has kernel
   198	`divisorWindow d ha1`, while the original widened certificate is used only to produce the
   199	fibre witnesses. -/
   200	theorem IsCertified.exists_chartAdaptation_thetaGluedEval_surjective
   201	    {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
   202	    {A : AffAdaptation D d} {g : Nat} (hc : A.IsCertified g)
   203	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   204	    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
   205	    (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : Int))
   206	    {a : Nat} (ha1 : Subsingleton (relTwistPair C k pi (relThetaCocycle C k pi a)).H1)
   207	    (hMa : windowM_choice pi hpi g ≤ a) :
   208	    ∃ B : DivisorAdaptation C R pi d, Function.Surjective (B.thetaGluedEval a) := by
   209	  obtain ⟨B⟩ := exists_divisorAdaptation C R pi d
   210	  refine ⟨B, B.thetaGluedEval_surjective_of_fibre_witness hpi (fun p => ?_)⟩
   211	  obtain ⟨W, hWclass, hWH1⟩ :=
   212	    hc.fibrewise_thetaSub_h1_witness C R pi hpi hO hchi ha1 hMa p
   213	  refine ⟨W, ?_, hWH1⟩
   214	  rw [BasicOpenCocycleDatum.cechPicClass_baseChange,
   215	    B.cechPicClass_thetaIdealDatum]
   216	  exact hWclass
   217	
   218	/-- The cover-independent widened window quotient therefore has a finite chart presentation:
   219	it is linearly equivalent to the theta-twisted colength module of an extracted adaptation.
   220	No certificate is transported to that adaptation (which would contradict the strict R2
   221	examples); only the intrinsic local equations and the right-exactness witness are used. -/
   222	theorem IsCertified.exists_chartAdaptation_windowQuotEquiv
   223	    {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
   224	    {A : AffAdaptation D d} {g : Nat} (hc : A.IsCertified g)
   225	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   226	    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
   227	    (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : Int))
   228	    {a : Nat} (ha1 : Subsingleton (relTwistPair C k pi (relThetaCocycle C k pi a)).H1)
   229	    (hMa : windowM_choice pi hpi g ≤ a) :
   230	    ∃ B : DivisorAdaptation C R pi d,
   231	      Nonempty (((R ⊗[k] ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤)) ⧸
   232	          divisorWindow d ha1) ≃ₗ[R] B.ThetaGlued a) := by
   233	  obtain ⟨B, hsurj⟩ := hc.exists_chartAdaptation_thetaGluedEval_surjective
   234	    C R pi hpi hO hchi ha1 hMa
   235	  exact ⟨B, ⟨windowQuotEquiv B ha1 hsurj⟩⟩
   236

     9	/-!
    10	# Fibre rank of the widened divisor window
    11	
    12	A widened certified adaptation cuts a degree-`g` divisor on every field-valued fibre.
    13	At a high theta window, the function-field dictionary identifies the complete window
    14	with `H^0(O(N(a)))` and its divisor window with `H^0(O(N(a) - d_K))`.  Both divisors
    15	have vanishing `H^1`, so Riemann--Roch and `deg(d_K) = g` show that the quotient has
    16	dimension `g`.
    17	
    18	The theorem below is intrinsic to the cover-independent `divisorWindow`.  In particular,
    19	it does not add a chart-typing premise or transport the widened certificate to an auxiliary
    20	chart adaptation.
    21	-/

   110	/-- On every field-valued fibre, the cover-independent high-window quotient cut out by a
   111	widened degree-`g` certificate has dimension exactly `g`. -/
   112	theorem IsCertified.finrank_windowQuotient_pulledEquations
   113	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   114	    [Algebra R K] [IsScalarTower k R K]
   115	    {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
   116	    {A : AffAdaptation D d} {g : Nat} (hc : A.IsCertified g)
   117	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   118	    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
   119	    (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : Int))
   120	    {a : Nat} (ha1 : Subsingleton (relTwistPair C k pi (relThetaCocycle C k pi a)).H1)
   121	    (hMa : windowM_choice pi hpi g ≤ a) :
   122	    Module.finrank K
   123	      ((K ⊗[k] ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤)) ⧸
   124	        divisorWindow (A.pulledEquations K hc.projective_colength) ha1) = g := by
   125	  let dK := A.pulledEquations K hc.projective_colength
   126	  let E := Scheme.presentationDivisor K dK.presentation
   127	  change Module.finrank K
   128	    ((K ⊗[k] ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤)) ⧸
   129	      divisorWindow dK ha1) = g
   130	  have hchiK : Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (g : Int) :=
   131	    chi_relCurve_of_chi_aff_rank C g hchi K
   132	  have hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg K E = (g : Int) := by
   133	    dsimp [E, dK]
   134	    exact hc.deg_presentationDivisor_pulledEquations (C := C) (R := R) (K := K)
   135	  have hN1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   136	      ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a)) 1) :=
   137	    subsingleton_h1_windowTransportDivisor C K pi a ha1
   138	  have hE1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K
   139	      (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a - E)) 1) :=
   140	    subsingleton_h1_windowTransportDivisor_sub C pi hpi K g a
   141	      ha1 hMa hO hchi hchiK E (by rw [hdeg]; omega)
   142	  have hNrr :
   143	      (Sheaf.h0 ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K
   144	        (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a)) : Int)
   145	        = Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg K (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a)
   146	          + Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) :=
   147	    h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one _ hN1
   148	  have hErr :
   149	      (Sheaf.h0 ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K
   150	        (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a - E)) : Int)
   151	        = Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg K (windowTransportDivisor C K pi a - E)

    20	  using the uniform `H^1` vanishing from `DivSchemeHighWindowH1`;
    21	* a projective high-window quotient is exactly a Grassmannian point, and its quotient

events.text: I’ve isolated the first reusable boundary: the ledger’s “genus” inequalities are the only arithmetic layer that actually needs both meanings. I’m adding an implicit Euler-characteristic parameter to those lemmas while retaining the existing positional window argument, so every diagonal caller elaborates unchanged and the widened path can pass `gamma` independently of its degree/rank `n`.

The diagnostic caught the real constraint cleanly: arbitrary `gamma,n` need the natural relation `gamma ≤ n` because the windows are budgeted for the divisor degree. I’m preserving the landed diagonal lemmas and adding `_at` arithmetic variants with that relation; the final admissible instantiation will discharge it from the existing coverage bound, so no user-facing hypothesis is added.

The first decoupled ledger block is compiling under the shared lake mutex. Its proofs use `gamma ≤ n` only to lift the old window inequalities; the existing diagonal theorem names remain untouched, which keeps downstream elaboration stable while I move the relation into the new spine.

events.text: The next unit is the transported-window core. It already separates the divisor `D'` from the ledger exponent; I’m generalizing its three rank/vanishing exports in place with `n`, implicit `gamma`, and an optional `gamma ≤ n` proof. The optional proof keeps every diagonal call source-compatible while exposing the exact relation to the new producer.

/-- The degree of `N` is the `k`-ledger embedding degree `M·δ`. -/
theorem deg_windowN (g : ℕ) :
    CurveDivisor.deg K (windowN C K hπ g)
      = (windowM_choice π hπ g : ℤ) * windowδ π :=
  deg_windowTransportDivisor C K π _

/-- **`hNdeg`**: `2g ≤ deg K N` — the transported embedding budget
(`two_mul_genus_le_M_mul_windowδ`). -/
theorem two_mul_genus_le_deg_windowN (g : ℕ)
    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ)) :
    2 * (g : ℤ) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K (windowN C K hπ g) := by
  rw [deg_windowN]
  exact two_mul_genus_le_M_mul_windowδ π hπ g hO hχ

/-- **`hNrank`**: the window-size transport `h⁰_K(𝒪(N)) = h⁰_k(𝒪(M·F))` — both sides
are computed by the rank anchor at their own field (`deg + χ`), the degree is the
transported `M·δ`, and `χ` matches through the genus normalizations. -/
theorem h0_windowN (g : ℕ)
    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
    (hχK : Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (g : ℤ)) :
    Sheaf.h0 ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K (windowN C K hπ g))
      = Sheaf.h0 (C.left.divisorSheaf k
          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)) := by
  have hK : (Sheaf.h0 ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K (windowN C K hπ g)) : ℤ)
      = CurveDivisor.deg K (windowN C K hπ g)
        + Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) :=
    h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one _ (subsingleton_h1_windowN C K hπ g)
  have hk : (Sheaf.h0 (C.left.divisorSheaf k
        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)) : ℤ)
      = (windowM_choice π hπ g : ℤ) * windowδ π + 1 - (g : ℤ) :=

/-- **`hNnorm`**: the transported normalization windows — for every `K`-divisor `D'` of
degree `≤ 2g`, `H¹(𝒪(N − D')) = 0`.  The π-free peeling at the transported multiplier
window `s·F` (or at `N` itself in the degenerate `windowBound ≤ 0` branch, where
`g = 0`), licensed by the ledger budgets. -/
theorem subsingleton_h1_windowN_sub (g : ℕ)
    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
    (hχK : Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
    (D' : (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor)
    (hD' : CurveDivisor.deg K D' ≤ 2 * (g : ℤ)) :
    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
      ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K (windowN C K hπ g - D')) 1) := by
  have hsub : CurveDivisor.deg K (windowN C K hπ g - D')
      = CurveDivisor.deg K (windowN C K hπ g) - CurveDivisor.deg K D' := by
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, CurveDivisor.deg_add, CurveDivisor.deg_neg, sub_eq_add_neg]
  by_cases hb : windowBound π hπ ≤ 0
  · -- degenerate branch: `g = 0`, peel from `N` itself
    have hg0 : g = 0 := genus_eq_zero_of_windowBound_nonpos π hπ g hb hO hχ
    refine subsingleton_hModule_one_of_witness K (windowN C K hπ g) _
      (subsingleton_h1_windowN C K hπ g) ?_
    rw [hsub, hχK, hg0]
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero] at hD' ⊢
    linarith
  · -- main branch: peel from the transported multiplier window `s·F`
    refine subsingleton_hModule_one_of_witness K
      (windowTransportDivisor C K π (windowS_choice π hπ g)) _
      (subsingleton_h1_windowTransportDivisor C K π _ (relThetaPairH1_windowS C hπ g))
      ?_
    rw [hsub, hχK, deg_windowN, deg_windowTransportDivisor]
    have hb1 : 0 < windowBound π hπ := not_le.mp hb
    have hM := windowM_spec π hπ g
    have hδ := one_le_windowδ π
    have hs : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (windowS_choice π hπ g : ℤ) := Int.natCast_nonneg _
    have hg : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (g : ℤ) := Int.natCast_nonneg _
    have hkey : (windowS_choice π hπ g : ℤ) * windowδ π + ((g : ℤ) + 2)
        ≤ ((g : ℤ) + 2) * ((windowS_choice π hπ g : ℤ) + 1) * windowδ π := by
      nlinarith [hs, hg, hδ, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℤ) ≤ (g:ℤ) + 1) hs)
        (by linarith : (0:ℤ) ≤ windowδ π)]
    linarith [hM, hkey, hb1, hD']

events.text: The gamma-zero audit found a genuine edge case: the old tower’s `windowBound > 0` was inferred from positive genus, so it could not serve an admissible positive degree on a genus-zero curve. I’m normalizing the ledger bound itself to a positive valid threshold (`max 1 rawBound`); its vanishing spec remains sound by monotonicity, and this removes the false “degree equals genus” degenerate branch without adding a hypothesis.

The ledger build is still running; the path audit also corrected the budget interpretation: the high-window divisor degree `n` needs the old `2n/3n` margins, while `gamma` enters only the Euler-characteristic terms. The positive normalized bound makes those degree budgets unconditional; I’ll add those degree-keyed exports before touching the fibre tower.

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.WindowLedgerF3
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.BaseDivisor
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# DDR-2 (mechanism) — the abstract window pinch (`informal/spec-dd-r.md` §1(ii))
    11	
    12	The pure Riemann–Roch mechanism of the certified-degree pinch, π-free: against an
    13	abstract embedding-level divisor `N` carrying the *transported* DD-0 window facts —
    14	`H¹(𝒪(N)) = 0` (`hNwin`), `H¹(𝒪(N − D')) = 0` for all `deg D' ≤ 2g` (`hNnorm`, the
    15	`N`-avatar of the ledger's `window_normalization`), and the budget `2g ≤ deg N`
    16	(`hNdeg`, the `N`-avatar of `two_mul_genus_le_M_mul_windowδ`) — a divisor `D` whose
    17	normalization window `H⁰(𝒪(N − D))` has corank exactly `g` in `H⁰(𝒪(N))` has
    18	`deg D = g`, and is recovered pointwise as the base divisor of that window.
    19	
    20	This is the form the fibrewise consumers (DDR-8) instantiate at a residue field
    21	`K = κ(p)`, where the window divisor is the *base-field transport* of `M·F` at the
    22	**base ledger constant** `M = windowM_choice π hπ g` — which need not agree with the
    23	`K`-level ledger constant (`windowBound` is a fixed choice per field), so the window
    24	facts enter as transported hypotheses, discharged by ledger names at the base field and
    25	moved across the extension by the DD-4 transport seam.
    26	
    27	* `AlgebraicGeometry.h0_window_sub_single_lt` — the strict drop at a point (abstract-`N`
    28	  transcription of P-fib's `h0_normalization_sub_single_lt`).
    29	* `AlgebraicGeometry.baseDivisorAt_window_normalization` — recovery of an effective
    30	  degree-`g` divisor from its window (abstract-`N` transcription of P-fib's
    31	  `baseDivisorAt_normalization`; the DDR-8 hook).
    32	* `AlgebraicGeometry.deg_eq_genus_of_window_corank` — **the pinch**: corank `g` forces
    33	  `deg D = g`.  First the DD-0 section bound (`h0_divisorSheaf_le_max_of_h0_one`) caps
    34	  `deg D ≤ 2g` (`h⁰(𝒪(N − D)) = deg N + 1 − 2g ≥ 1`, F1's move), then the exact
    35	  normalization window reads the degree off the corank.  No carve, no Mayer–Vietoris,
    36	  no adaptation independence, no `hdeg`.
    37	* `AlgebraicGeometry.deg_eq_genus_of_normalization_corank` — the ledger form: at the
    38	  pack's own DD-0 constants the three `N`-hypotheses ARE the ledger names
    39	  `window_embedding` / `window_normalization` / `two_mul_genus_le_M_mul_windowδ`.
    40	
    41	No numeric window bound appears (DAT-D discipline rule 1).  The family-level
    42	deliverables (`deg_divFamDivisor_of_carve`, `baseDivisor_eq_divFamDivisor_of_carve`)
    43	are in `RiemannRoch/CarveDegree.lean`.
    44	-/
    45	
    46	set_option autoImplicit false
    47	
    48	universe u
    49	
    50	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
    51	
    52	attribute [local instance] AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.functionFieldOverModule
    53	  AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.overModule
    54	
    55	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    56	
    57	open Scheme
    58	
    59	section WindowPinch
    60	
    61	variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y]
    62	  [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    63	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    64	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    65	  [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    66	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
    67	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 1)]
    68	
    69	/-- **The strict drop at a point, abstract window form**: for an effective `D'` of degree
    70	`g` under an embedding level `N` with exact normalization windows (`hNnorm`) and budget
    71	`2g ≤ deg N`, adding any closed point strictly drops `h⁰(𝒪(N − D'))`: when `deg x ≤ g`
    72	both normalization windows are exact and the drop is `deg x ≥ 1`; when `deg x > g` the
    73	raw DD-0 section bound undercuts the window value.  The abstract-`N` transcription of
    74	P-fib's `h0_normalization_sub_single_lt` (consumed fibrewise by DDR-8, where `N` is the
    75	base-field transport of the ledger window `M·F`). -/
    76	lemma h0_window_sub_single_lt (g : ℕ)
    77	    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1)
    78	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
    79	    (N : Y.CurveDivisor)
    80	    (hNnorm : ∀ D' : Y.CurveDivisor, CurveDivisor.deg K D' ≤ 2 * (g : ℤ) →
    81	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D')) 1))
    82	    (hNdeg : 2 * (g : ℤ) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K N)
    83	    (D' : Y.CurveDivisor) (hdeg : CurveDivisor.deg K D' = (g : ℤ))
    84	    {x : Y} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint Y) :
    85	    Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D' - CurveDivisor.single hx 1))
    86	      < Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D')) := by
    87	  have hdx : 0 < Y.residueDeg K x := Scheme.residueDeg_pos hx
    88	  have hdxz : (1 : ℤ) ≤ (Y.residueDeg K x : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hdx
    89	  have hdegsingle : CurveDivisor.deg K (CurveDivisor.single hx 1)
    90	      = 1 * (Y.residueDeg K x : ℤ) := CurveDivisor.deg_single K ⟨x, hx⟩ 1
    91	  have hgnn : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (g : ℤ) := Int.natCast_nonneg g
    92	  have hg2 : CurveDivisor.deg K D' ≤ 2 * (g : ℤ) := by omega
    93	  have hbig : (Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D')) : ℤ)
    94	      = CurveDivisor.deg K N - CurveDivisor.deg K D'
    95	        + Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) := by
    96	    rw [h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one _ (hNnorm D' hg2),
    97	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' K]
    98	  rw [hχ, hdeg] at hbig
    99	  have hsplit : N - D' - CurveDivisor.single hx 1
   100	      = N - (D' + CurveDivisor.single hx 1) := by
   101	    abel
   102	  have hdegD'x : CurveDivisor.deg K (D' + CurveDivisor.single hx 1)
   103	      = (g : ℤ) + (Y.residueDeg K x : ℤ) := by
   104	    rw [CurveDivisor.deg_add, hdeg, hdegsingle]
   105	    ring
   106	  by_cases hd : (Y.residueDeg K x : ℤ) ≤ (g : ℤ)
   107	  · -- small residue degree: both windows are exact
   108	    have hg2' : CurveDivisor.deg K (D' + CurveDivisor.single hx 1) ≤ 2 * (g : ℤ) := by
   109	      omega
   110	    have hsmall : (Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K
   111	          (N - (D' + CurveDivisor.single hx 1))) : ℤ)
   112	        = CurveDivisor.deg K N
   113	            - CurveDivisor.deg K (D' + CurveDivisor.single hx 1)
   114	          + Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) := by
   115	      rw [h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one _ (hNnorm _ hg2'),
   116	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' K]
   117	    rw [hχ, hdegD'x] at hsmall
   118	    rw [hsplit]
   119	    omega
   120	  · -- large residue degree: the section bound undercuts the window
   121	    have hsec := h0_divisorSheaf_le_max_of_h0_one K hO
   122	      (N - D' - CurveDivisor.single hx 1)
   123	    have hdegsub : CurveDivisor.deg K (N - D' - CurveDivisor.single hx 1)
   124	        = CurveDivisor.deg K N - (g : ℤ) - (Y.residueDeg K x : ℤ) := by
   125	      rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' K, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' K, hdeg,
   126	        hdegsingle]
   127	      ring
   128	    rw [hdegsub] at hsec
   129	    rcases le_max_iff.mp hsec with h0le | hvle
   130	    · omega
   131	    · omega
   132	
   133	/-- **Recovery of the divisor from its window, abstract window form** (the DDR-8 hook):
   134	for an effective `D'` of degree `g` under an embedding level `N` with exact
   135	normalization windows and budget `2g ≤ deg N`, the base multiplicity of
   136	`H⁰(𝒪(N − D'))` relative to `N` at every closed point is exactly `D'ₓ` — `≥` because
   137	every section obeys the pole bound, `≤` because the strict drop provides a section not
   138	vanishing one order deeper.  The abstract-`N` transcription of P-fib's
   139	`baseDivisorAt_normalization`. -/
   140	lemma baseDivisorAt_window_normalization (g : ℕ)
   141	    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1)
   142	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
   143	    (N : Y.CurveDivisor)
   144	    (hNnorm : ∀ D' : Y.CurveDivisor, CurveDivisor.deg K D' ≤ 2 * (g : ℤ) →
   145	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D')) 1))
   146	    (hNdeg : 2 * (g : ℤ) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K N)
   147	    (D' : Y.CurveDivisor) (hD'0 : 0 ≤ D')
   148	    (hdeg : CurveDivisor.deg K D' = (g : ℤ)) {x : Y} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint Y) :
   149	    (Scheme.baseDivisorAt K (divisorSections K (N - D') ⊤) N ⟨x, hx⟩ : ℤ)
   150	      = coeffAt hx D' := by
   151	  set T : Submodule K Y.functionField := divisorSections K (N - D') ⊤ with hT
   152	  have hTA : T ≤ divisorSections K N ⊤ := by
   153	    rw [hT]
   154	    refine divisorSections_mono K ?_ ⊤
   155	    refine CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mpr (fun y hy => ?_)
   156	    have h0y := CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mp hD'0 y hy
   157	    rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero] at h0y
   158	    rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub]
   159	    omega
   160	  have hgnn : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (g : ℤ) := Int.natCast_nonneg g
   161	  have hg2 : CurveDivisor.deg K D' ≤ 2 * (g : ℤ) := by omega
   162	  have hrank : (Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D')) : ℤ)
   163	      = CurveDivisor.deg K N - CurveDivisor.deg K D'
   164	        + Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) := by
   165	    rw [h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one _ (hNnorm D' hg2),
   166	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' K]
   167	  rw [hχ, hdeg] at hrank
   168	  have hfr : Module.finrank K ↥T = Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D')) := by
   169	    rw [hT]
   170	    exact finrank_divisorSections_top K _
   171	  have hTne : ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ 0 := by
   172	    refine Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot (fun hbot => ?_)
   173	    have := hfr
   174	    rw [hbot, finrank_bot] at this
   175	    omega
   176	  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
   177	  · -- `≤`: the strict drop provides an exact section
   178	    have hlt : Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D' - CurveDivisor.single hx 1))
   179	        < Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D')) :=
   180	      h0_window_sub_single_lt g hO hχ N hNnorm hNdeg D' hdeg hx
   181	    have hle : divisorSections K (N - D' - CurveDivisor.single hx 1) ⊤ ≤ T := by
   182	      rw [hT]
   183	      refine divisorSections_mono K ?_ ⊤
   184	      refine CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mpr (fun y hy => ?_)
   185	      by_cases hyx : y = x
   186	      · subst hyx
   187	        rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub,
   188	          CurveDivisor.coeffAt_single_self]
   189	        omega
   190	      · rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub,
   191	          CurveDivisor.coeffAt_single_of_ne hx hy hyx]
   192	        omega
   193	    have hne : divisorSections K (N - D' - CurveDivisor.single hx 1) ⊤ ≠ T := by
   194	      intro heq
   195	      have hfr2 : Module.finrank K
   196	          ↥(divisorSections K (N - D' - CurveDivisor.single hx 1) ⊤)
   197	          = Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D' - CurveDivisor.single hx 1)) :=
   198	        finrank_divisorSections_top K _
   199	      rw [heq, hfr] at hfr2
   200	      omega
   201	    obtain ⟨f, hfT, hfnot⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_ne hle hne)
   202	    have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := by
   203	      intro h0
   204	      exact hfnot (h0 ▸ Submodule.zero_mem _)
   205	    -- `f` obeys the `D'`-bound everywhere and violates the deeper bound at `x`
   206	    have hmem := (mem_divisorSections_top_iff K hf0).mp (hT ▸ hfT)

   213	        + Scheme.divOf (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (Units.mk0 f hf0))
   214	        ≤ coeffAt hx D' := by
   215	      by_contra hgt
   216	      apply hviol

   218	      have hy0 := CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mp hmem y hy

   220	      rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub] at hy0

   240	/-- **The residual base multiplicity vanishes in the normalized window.**  The

   242	generic normalization lemma then says that the same section space has no residual
   243	base point relative to `N - D`. -/
   244	lemma baseDivisorAt_window_residual_eq_zero (g : ℕ)
   245	    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1)
   246	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
   247	    (N : Y.CurveDivisor)
   248	    (hNnorm : ∀ D' : Y.CurveDivisor, CurveDivisor.deg K D' ≤ 2 * (g : ℤ) →
   249	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D')) 1))
   250	    (hNdeg : 2 * (g : ℤ) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K N)
   251	    (D : Y.CurveDivisor) (hD0 : 0 ≤ D)
   252	    (hdeg : CurveDivisor.deg K D = (g : ℤ)) {x : Y} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint Y) :
   253	    (Scheme.baseDivisorAt K (divisorSections K (N - D) ⊤) (N - D) ⟨x, hx⟩ : ℤ) = 0 := by
   254	  let T : Submodule K Y.functionField := divisorSections K (N - D) ⊤
   255	  have hne : ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ 0 := by
   256	    have hgnn : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (g : ℤ) := Int.natCast_nonneg g
   257	    have hg2 : CurveDivisor.deg K D ≤ 2 * (g : ℤ) := by omega
   258	    have hrank : (Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D)) : ℤ)
   259	        = CurveDivisor.deg K N - CurveDivisor.deg K D
   260	          + Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) := by
   261	      rw [h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one _ (hNnorm D hg2),
   262	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' K]
   263	    rw [hχ, hdeg] at hrank
   264	    have hfr : Module.finrank K (T : Type u) = Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D)) := by
   265	      rw [show T = divisorSections K (N - D) ⊤ from rfl]
   266	      exact finrank_divisorSections_top K _
   267	    refine Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot (fun hbot => ?_)
   268	    rw [hbot, finrank_bot] at hfr
   269	    omega
   270	  have hTA : T ≤ divisorSections K N ⊤ := by
   271	    rw [show T = divisorSections K (N - D) ⊤ from rfl]
   272	    refine divisorSections_mono K ?_ ⊤
   273	    refine CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mpr (fun y hy ↦ ?_)
   274	    have h0y := CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mp hD0 y hy
   275	    rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero] at h0y
   276	    rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub]
   277	    omega
   278	  have hbase : Scheme.baseDivisor K T N hne = D := by
   279	    refine CurveDivisor.ext_coeffAt (fun y hy => ?_)
   280	    rw [Scheme.coeffAt_baseDivisor K hne hy]
   281	    simpa [T] using (baseDivisorAt_window_normalization g hO hχ N hNnorm hNdeg D hD0 hdeg hy)
   282	  have hres := Scheme.baseDivisorAt_sub_baseDivisor_eq_zero K hTA hne hx
   283	  rw [hbase] at hres
   284	  exact_mod_cast hres

   287	/-- **The certified-degree pinch, abstract window form** (spec-dd-r §1(ii)): a divisor
   288	`D` whose normalization window `H⁰(𝒪(N − D))` has corank exactly `g` inside an exact
   289	embedding window `H⁰(𝒪(N))` of budget `2g ≤ deg N` has `deg D = g`.  First the DD-0
   290	section bound caps `deg D ≤ 2g` (`h⁰(𝒪(N − D)) = deg N + 1 − 2g ≥ 1`, F1's move), then
   291	the exact normalization window reads the degree off the corank.  No carve, no
   292	Mayer–Vietoris, no adaptation independence. -/
   293	theorem deg_eq_genus_of_window_corank (g : ℕ)
   294	    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1)
   295	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
   296	    (N : Y.CurveDivisor)
   297	    (hNwin : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K N) 1))
   298	    (hNnorm : ∀ D' : Y.CurveDivisor, CurveDivisor.deg K D' ≤ 2 * (g : ℤ) →
   299	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D')) 1))
   300	    (hNdeg : 2 * (g : ℤ) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K N)
   301	    (D : Y.CurveDivisor)
   302	    (hcorank : Module.finrank K ↥(divisorSections K (N - D) ⊤) + g
   303	      = Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K N)) :
   304	    CurveDivisor.deg K D = (g : ℤ) := by
   305	  have hrN : (Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K N) : ℤ)
   306	      = CurveDivisor.deg K N + Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) :=
   307	    h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one _ hNwin
   308	  rw [hχ] at hrN
   309	  have hfr : Module.finrank K ↥(divisorSections K (N - D) ⊤)
   310	      = Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D)) := finrank_divisorSections_top K _
   311	  rw [hfr] at hcorank
   312	  have hdegND : CurveDivisor.deg K (N - D)
   313	      = CurveDivisor.deg K N - CurveDivisor.deg K D :=
   314	    Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' K N D
   315	  -- F1: the section bound caps `deg D ≤ 2g`
   316	  have hsec := h0_divisorSheaf_le_max_of_h0_one K hO (N - D)
   317	  rw [hdegND] at hsec

   319	    rcases le_max_iff.mp hsec with h0le | hvle
   320	    · omega
   321	    · omega
   322	  -- the exact normalization window reads off the degree
   323	  have hnorm : (Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D)) : ℤ)
   324	      = CurveDivisor.deg K N - CurveDivisor.deg K D
   325	        + Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) := by
   326	    rw [h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one _ (hNnorm D hD2g), hdegND]
   327	  rw [hχ] at hnorm
   328	  omega

   335	/-- **The certified-degree pinch, ledger form**: at the pack's own DD-0 window

   108	    (windowA_choice π hπ : ℤ) * windowδ π < windowBound π hπ + windowδ π := by
   109	  have h1 : windowA_choice π hπ - 1 < windowA_choice π hπ :=
   110	    Nat.sub_lt (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero ha) one_pos
   111	  have hmin : ¬ (windowBound π hπ
   112	      ≤ ((windowA_choice π hπ - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) * windowδ π) :=
   113	    Nat.find_min (windowA_exists π hπ) h1
   114	  have hcast : ((windowA_choice π hπ - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (windowA_choice π hπ : ℤ) - 1 := by
   115	    have := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha
   116	    omega
   117	  rw [hcast] at hmin
   118	  push Not at hmin
   119	  have hexp : ((windowA_choice π hπ : ℤ) - 1) * windowδ π
   120	      = (windowA_choice π hπ : ℤ) * windowδ π - windowδ π := by ring
   121	  linarith

   126	  have hspec := windowA_spec π hπ

   153	theorem windowA_add_three_mul_genus_add_S_le_M_mul (hb : 0 < windowBound π hπ) (g : ℕ) :

   158	  have hM := windowM_spec π hπ g

   296	/-- **The fibre P-fib-N keystone at the transported windows** (worksheet §1.5, the
   297	G-4 fibre heart): on the fibre curve over any field extension `K/k`, subspaces
   298	`K_M ⊆ H⁰(𝒪(N))` and `K' ⊆ H⁰(𝒪(N + S))` of corank exactly `g` at the transported
   299	windows `N = windowN` (the `M·F`-transport) and `S = windowS` (the `s·F`-transport),
   300	satisfying the elementwise carve `(♦)`, determine a **unique** effective divisor `D`
   301	of degree `g` with `K_M = H⁰(𝒪(N − D))` and `K' = H⁰(𝒪(N + S − D))`.
   302	
   303	Every pack slot of `existsUnique_effective_divisor_of_carve_pack` is discharged:
   304	`hvan` by witness peeling at the minimal exponent `a` (threshold `β = a·δ + g`),
   305	`hNdeg` by `two_mul_genus_le_deg_windowN`, `hSdeg` by `two_mul_genus_le_S_mul_windowδ`,
   306	the budgets by `windowA_add_three_mul_genus_le_S_mul` (I-0234's `windowS_spec_three`)
   307	and `windowA_add_three_mul_genus_add_S_le_M_mul`.  In the degenerate ledger branch
   308	`windowBound ≤ 0` the genus is zero and `D = 0` is forced directly. -/
   309	theorem existsUnique_effective_divisor_of_carve_windowN (g : ℕ)
   310	    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
   311	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
   312	    (hOK : Sheaf.h0 ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) = 1)
   313	    (hχK : Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
   314	    (KM : Submodule K (relCurve C K).functionField)
   315	    (hKM : KM ≤ divisorSections K (windowN C K hπ g) ⊤)
   316	    (hKMrank : Module.finrank K ↥KM + g
   317	      = Sheaf.h0 ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K (windowN C K hπ g)))
   318	    (K' : Submodule K (relCurve C K).functionField)
   319	    (hK' : K' ≤ divisorSections K (windowN C K hπ g + windowS C K hπ g) ⊤)
   320	    (hK'rank : Module.finrank K ↥K' + g
   321	      = Sheaf.h0 ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K
   322	          (windowN C K hπ g + windowS C K hπ g)))
   323	    (hcarve : ∀ h ∈ divisorSections K (windowS C K hπ g) ⊤, ∀ f ∈ KM, h * f ∈ K') :
   324	    ∃! D : (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor, 0 ≤ D ∧ CurveDivisor.deg K D = (g : ℤ) ∧
   325	      KM = divisorSections K (windowN C K hπ g - D) ⊤ ∧
   326	      K' = divisorSections K (windowN C K hπ g + windowS C K hπ g - D) ⊤ := by
   327	  by_cases hb : windowBound π hπ ≤ 0
   328	  · -- degenerate ledger branch: `g = 0`, the divisor is forced to be `0`
   329	    have hg0 : g = 0 := genus_eq_zero_of_windowBound_nonpos π hπ g hb hO hχ
   330	    subst hg0
   331	    have hKMeq : KM = divisorSections K (windowN C K hπ 0) ⊤ := by
   332	      refine Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le hKM ?_
   333	      rw [finrank_divisorSections_top K _]
   334	      omega
   335	    have hK'eq : K' = divisorSections K (windowN C K hπ 0 + windowS C K hπ 0) ⊤ := by
   336	      refine Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le hK' ?_
   337	      rw [finrank_divisorSections_top K _]
   338	      omega
   339	    refine ⟨0, ⟨le_rfl, by rw [CurveDivisor.deg_zero, Nat.cast_zero], ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
   340	    · rw [sub_zero]; exact hKMeq
   341	    · rw [sub_zero]; exact hK'eq
   342	    · rintro D' ⟨hD'0, hD'deg, -, -⟩
   343	      refine Scheme.CurveDivisor.eq_zero_of_deg_le_zero K hD'0 ?_
   344	      rw [hD'deg, Nat.cast_zero]
   345	  · -- main branch: `0 < b`, the pack fires at threshold `β = a·δ + g`
   346	    push Not at hb
   347	    refine existsUnique_effective_divisor_of_carve_pack g hOK hχK
   348	      (windowN C K hπ g) (windowS C K hπ g)
   349	      ((windowA_choice π hπ : ℤ) * windowδ π + (g : ℤ))
   350	      (fun W hW => subsingleton_h1_of_windowA_le_deg C K hπ g hχK W hW)
   351	      (two_mul_genus_le_deg_windowN C K hπ g hO hχ)
   352	      (by rw [deg_windowS]
   353	          exact two_mul_genus_le_S_mul_windowδ π hπ g hO hχ)
   354	      (by rw [deg_windowS]
   355	          have := windowA_add_three_mul_genus_le_S_mul π hπ hb g
   356	          linarith)
   357	      (by rw [deg_windowS, deg_windowN]
   358	          have := windowA_add_three_mul_genus_add_S_le_M_mul π hπ hb g
   359	          linarith)
   360	      KM hKM hKMrank K' hK' hK'rank hcarve
   361

    13	(`RiemannRoch/PFib.lean`, `existsUnique_effective_divisor_of_carve`) is pinned to the
    14	fibre field's OWN ledger constants `windowM_choice π hπ g`, and per the I-0204 binding
    15	finding the ledger constants do NOT transport across `k → κ(p)`
    16	(`RiemannRoch/WindowFieldTransport.lean`).  This file restates the whole P-fib chain
    17	π-free, against ABSTRACT embedding/multiplier divisors `N` (∼ the transported `M·F`)
    18	and `S` (∼ the transported `s·F`), shifted window spelled `N + S` (∼ `(M+s)·F`).
    19	
    20	## The pack interface (the §1.4 audit result)
    21	
    22	The §1.4-mandated audit of the bpf-span window threading found the five-fact list
    23	sketched there (`hNwin`/`hSwin`/`hNdeg`/`hNnorm`/`hNsnorm`) **insufficient** — the descent
    24	stage of the F3-core (`Scheme.descent_baseDivisor_le`) visits levels `N + S − D − G`
    25	with `deg G ≤ 2·deg S`, far below the `deg ≤ 2g` normalization families, and the tower
    26	stage visits multiplier levels `S − E + j·x − div fₓ` at depth `deg E ≤ 2g` below `S`.
    27	The honest transported interface is the DAT-0a avatar itself: a **vanishing threshold**
    28	`β` with `hvan : ∀ W, β ≤ deg W → H¹(𝒪(W)) = 0` (the `windowBound_spec` shape — at a
    29	residue field it is produced by the π-free peeling `subsingleton_hModule_one_of_witness`
    30	from a transported witness, or from a transported normalization family via
    31	`subsingleton_hModule_one_of_normalization` below), plus the three budget avatars

    33	* `hSdeg : 2g ≤ deg S`   (avatar of `two_mul_genus_le_S_mul_windowδ`),
    34	* `hβS : β + 2g ≤ deg S`  (tower budget, `windowBound_add_windowδ_le_S_mul_sub`),
    35	* `hβN : β + 2g + deg S ≤ deg N`  (descent budget, verbatim
    36	  `windowBound_add_two_mul_genus_le_M_sub_S_mul`),
    37	
    38	and `hNdeg : 2g ≤ deg N` (avatar of `two_mul_genus_le_M_mul_windowδ`).  The worksheet's
    39	`hNwin`/`hSwin`/`hNnorm`/`hNsnorm` are one-line consequences of `hvan` + budgets,

    43	* `AlgebraicGeometry.subsingleton_hModule_one_of_normalization` — a normalization family
    44	  at depth `t` below `N₀` IS a vanishing threshold at `β = deg N₀ − t`; turns the landed

    46	* `AlgebraicGeometry.mulSpan_eq_divisorSections_of_basepointFree_pack` — the F3-core

    73	variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y]
    74	  [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    75	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    76	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

    85	/-- **A normalization family is a vanishing threshold**: if `H¹(𝒪(N₀ − D')) = 0` for
    86	every divisor `D'` of degree `≤ t`, then every divisor `W` of degree `≥ deg N₀ − t` has
    87	vanishing `H¹` — write `W = N₀ − (N₀ − W)` and feed `N₀ − W` to the family.  This turns
    88	the landed fibre fact `subsingleton_h1_windowN_sub` (`WindowFieldTransport.lean`) into
    89	the `hvan` threshold of the P-fib-N pack at `β = deg N − 2g`. -/
    90	theorem subsingleton_hModule_one_of_normalization
    91	    (t : ℤ) (N₀ : Y.CurveDivisor)
    92	    (hnorm : ∀ D' : Y.CurveDivisor, CurveDivisor.deg K D' ≤ t →
    93	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K (N₀ - D')) 1))
    94	    (W : Y.CurveDivisor)
    95	    (hW : CurveDivisor.deg K N₀ - t ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K W) :
    96	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K W) 1) := by
    97	  have hdeg : CurveDivisor.deg K (N₀ - W) ≤ t := by
    98	    rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' K]
    99	    omega
   100	  have h := hnorm (N₀ - W) hdeg
   101	  rwa [sub_sub_cancel] at h
   102	
   103	/-- **The bpf-span lemma, pack form** (F3-core against the transported window pack; the
   104	abstract-`N,S` transcription of `mulSpan_eq_divisorSections_of_basepointFree`,
   105	`RiemannRoch/BpfSpan.lean`): for an effective `D` of degree `≤ g` and a subspace
   106	`T ⊆ H⁰(𝒪(N − D))` of codimension `c ≤ g` with no base point relative to `N − D`, the
   107	products by the full multiplier window span the full shifted window:
   108	`span(H⁰(𝒪(S)) · T) = H⁰(𝒪(N + S − D))`.  The ledger names of the original are replaced
   109	by the pack: `windowBound_spec ↦ hvan` (threshold `β`),
   110	`two_mul_genus_le_S_mul_windowδ ↦ hSdeg`, the tower budget `↦ hβS`, the descent budget
   111	`↦ hβN`; the descent/tower engines (`BpfSpanCore.lean`) are window-generic and consumed
   112	as-is. -/
   113	theorem mulSpan_eq_divisorSections_of_basepointFree_pack
   114	    (g : ℕ) (hO : Sheaf.h0 (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1)
   115	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
   116	    (N S : Y.CurveDivisor) (β : ℤ)
   117	    (hvan : ∀ W : Y.CurveDivisor, β ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K W →
   118	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K W) 1))
   119	    (hSdeg : 2 * (g : ℤ) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K S)
   120	    (hβS : β + 2 * (g : ℤ) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K S)
   121	    (hβN : β + 2 * (g : ℤ) + CurveDivisor.deg K S ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K N)
   122	    (D : Y.CurveDivisor) (hD0 : 0 ≤ D)
   123	    (hDg : CurveDivisor.deg K D ≤ (g : ℤ))
   124	    (T : Submodule K Y.functionField)
   125	    (hTN : T ≤ divisorSections K (N - D) ⊤)
   126	    (c : ℕ) (hcg : c ≤ g)
   127	    (hc : Module.finrank K ↥T + c = Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D)))
   128	    (hbpf : ∀ (x : Y) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint Y),
   129	      ∃ (f : Y.functionField) (_ : f ∈ T) (hf : f ≠ 0),
   130	        coeffAt hx ((N - D)
   131	          + Scheme.divOf (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (Units.mk0 f hf)) = 0) :
   132	    Scheme.mulSpan K (divisorSections K S ⊤) T
   133	      = divisorSections K (N + S - D) ⊤ := by
   134	  classical
   135	  set ND : Y.CurveDivisor := N - D with hND
   136	  -- degree bookkeeping
   137	  have hD0deg : 0 ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K D := Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_nonneg K hD0
   138	  have hdegND : CurveDivisor.deg K ND
   139	      = CurveDivisor.deg K N - CurveDivisor.deg K D := by
   140	    rw [hND, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' K]
   141	  have hSdeg0 : 0 ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K S := by omega
   142	  -- the multiplier window is exact: `h⁰(𝒪(S)) = deg S + 1 − g`
   143	  have hrs : (Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K S) : ℤ)
   144	      = CurveDivisor.deg K S + 1 - (g : ℤ) := by
   145	    rw [h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one _ (hvan S (by omega)), hχ]
   146	    ring
   147	  -- the target window is `ND + S`
   148	  have hdivEq : N + S - D = ND + S := by
   149	    rw [hND]
   150	    abel
   151	  rw [hdivEq]
   152	  -- the easy inclusion: products satisfy the pole bound
   153	  have hSle : Scheme.mulSpan K (divisorSections K S ⊤) T
   154	      ≤ divisorSections K (ND + S) ⊤ := by
   155	    refine Scheme.mulSpan_le K (fun a ha f hf => ?_)
   156	    have hmul := mul_mem_divisorSections_top K ha (hTN hf)
   157	    rwa [add_comm S ND] at hmul
   158	  refine le_antisymm hSle (Submodule.le_of_forall_dual_ker ?_)
   159	  intro Λ hSΛ
   160	  -- the annihilator kernel of `Λ`
   161	  set NL : Submodule K Y.functionField :=
   162	    Scheme.annKernel K (divisorSections K S ⊤) (divisorSections K ND ⊤) Λ with hNLdef
   163	  have hNLleS : NL ≤ divisorSections K S ⊤ := Scheme.annKernel_le K _ _ Λ
   164	  -- (3a) codimension bound
   165	  have hkill : ∀ h ∈ divisorSections K S ⊤, ∀ f ∈ T, Λ (h * f) = 0 := by
   166	    intro h hh f hf
   167	    exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mp (hSΛ (Scheme.mul_mem_mulSpan K hh hf))
   168	  have hcodim : Module.finrank K ↥(divisorSections K S ⊤)
   169	      ≤ Module.finrank K ↥NL + c := by
   170	    refine finrank_le_finrank_annKernel_add K hTN ?_ hkill
   171	    rw [finrank_divisorSections_top K ND]
   172	    exact hc
   173	  -- (3a′) `N_Λ` is nonzero
   174	  have hfrS : Module.finrank K ↥(divisorSections K S ⊤)
   175	      = Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K S) := finrank_divisorSections_top K S
   176	  have hNLpos : 0 < Module.finrank K ↥NL := by
   177	    have h1 : (Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K S) : ℤ)
   178	        ≤ (Module.finrank K ↥NL : ℤ) + c := by
   179	      exact_mod_cast hfrS ▸ hcodim
   180	    omega
   181	  have hNLne : ∃ f ∈ NL, f ≠ 0 := by
   182	    have : NL ≠ ⊥ := by
   183	      intro hbot
   184	      rw [hbot, finrank_bot] at hNLpos
   185	      omega
   186	    exact Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot this
   187	  -- (3b) the base locus of `N_Λ` and its degree bound
   188	  set E : Y.CurveDivisor := Scheme.baseDivisor K NL S hNLne with hEdef
   189	  have hE0 : 0 ≤ E := Scheme.baseDivisor_nonneg K hNLne
   190	  have hEdeg : CurveDivisor.deg K E ≤ (g : ℤ) + c := by
   191	    have hsub : NL ≤ divisorSections K (S - E) ⊤ :=
   192	      Scheme.le_divisorSections_sub_baseDivisor K hNLleS hNLne
   193	    have hmono : Module.finrank K ↥NL
   194	        ≤ Module.finrank K ↥(divisorSections K (S - E) ⊤) :=
   195	      Submodule.finrank_mono hsub
   196	    have hbr := finrank_divisorSections_top K (S - E)
   197	    have hpos : 0 < Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (S - E)) := by
   198	      omega
   199	    have hsec := h0_le_deg_add_one_of_pos K hO (S - E) hpos
   200	    have hdegSE : CurveDivisor.deg K (S - E)
   201	        = CurveDivisor.deg K S - CurveDivisor.deg K E :=
   202	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' K S E
   203	    rw [hdegSE] at hsec
   204	    omega
   205	  -- (3c) the descent: `Λ` kills `H⁰(𝒪(ND + S − E))`
   206	  have hkillsSh : ∀ (h : Y.functionField) (_ : h ∈ NL) (hne : h ≠ 0),
   207	      divisorSections K
   208	        ((ND + S) - (S + Scheme.divOf (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (Units.mk0 h hne))) ⊤
   209	        ≤ LinearMap.ker Λ := by
   210	    intro h hh hne
   211	    have hdiveq : (ND + S)
   212	        - (S + Scheme.divOf (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (Units.mk0 h hne))
   213	        = ND - Scheme.divOf (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (Units.mk0 h hne) := by
   214	      abel
   215	    rw [hdiveq, ← map_mulLinear_divisorSections_top K hne ND]
   216	    rintro _ ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
   217	    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, Scheme.mulLinear_apply]
   218	    exact (Scheme.mem_annKernel K).mp hh |>.2 f hf
   219	  have hwin_descent : ∀ G : Y.CurveDivisor, 0 ≤ G →
   220	      CurveDivisor.deg K G ≤ 2 * CurveDivisor.deg K S →
   221	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K ((ND + S) - G)) 1) := by
   222	    intro G hG0 hGdeg
   223	    refine hvan _ ?_
   224	    rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' K, CurveDivisor.deg_add, hdegND]
   225	    omega
   226	  have hkillsE : divisorSections K ((ND + S) - E) ⊤ ≤ LinearMap.ker Λ := by
   227	    rw [hEdef]
   228	    exact Scheme.descent_baseDivisor_le K (ND + S) S hSdeg0 NL hNLne hNLleS
   229	      hwin_descent (LinearMap.ker Λ) hkillsSh
   230	  -- (3e) the tower at each point of `E`
   231	  have htower : ∀ (x : Y) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint Y),
   232	      divisorSections K ((ND + S) - E + CurveDivisor.single hx (coeffAt hx E)) ⊤
   233	        ≤ LinearMap.ker Λ := by
   234	    intro x hx
   235	    obtain ⟨fx, hfxT, hfx, hfxord⟩ := hbpf x hx
   236	    have hfxmem : 0 ≤ ND
   237	        + Scheme.divOf (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (Units.mk0 fx hfx) :=
   238	      (mem_divisorSections_top_iff K hfx).mp (hTN hfxT)
   239	    have he0 : 0 ≤ coeffAt hx E := by

    11	
    12	The pure Riemann–Roch mechanism of the certified-degree pinch, π-free: against an
    13	abstract embedding-level divisor `N` carrying the *transported* DD-0 window facts —
    14	`H¹(𝒪(N)) = 0` (`hNwin`), `H¹(𝒪(N − D')) = 0` for all `deg D' ≤ 2g` (`hNnorm`, the
    15	`N`-avatar of the ledger's `window_normalization`), and the budget `2g ≤ deg N`
    16	(`hNdeg`, the `N`-avatar of `two_mul_genus_le_M_mul_windowδ`) — a divisor `D` whose
    17	normalization window `H⁰(𝒪(N − D))` has corank exactly `g` in `H⁰(𝒪(N))` has
    18	`deg D = g`, and is recovered pointwise as the base divisor of that window.
    19	
    20	This is the form the fibrewise consumers (DDR-8) instantiate at a residue field
    21	`K = κ(p)`, where the window divisor is the *base-field transport* of `M·F` at the
    22	**base ledger constant** `M = windowM_choice π hπ g` — which need not agree with the
    23	`K`-level ledger constant (`windowBound` is a fixed choice per field), so the window
    24	facts enter as transported hypotheses, discharged by ledger names at the base field and
    25	moved across the extension by the DD-4 transport seam.

    28	  transcription of P-fib's `h0_normalization_sub_single_lt`).
    29	* `AlgebraicGeometry.baseDivisorAt_window_normalization` — recovery of an effective
    30	  degree-`g` divisor from its window (abstract-`N` transcription of P-fib's

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepAffChallenge
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AtlasFromDivRepAff
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartAtlasCoupling
     9	
    10	/-!
    11	# The widened divisor representer at the Picard atlas seam
    12	
    13	The widened divisor functor of a challenge curve is represented at the genus parameter.  This
    14	module inserts that representation into the Abel construction and then into the Zariski-local
    15	representability theorem for the degree-zero Picard functor.
    16	
    17	The resulting chart family has no assumed divisor representation.  Its remaining inputs are the
    18	two geometric conditions of the local-representability theorem: every restricted Abel map is a
    19	representable open immersion, and the restricted maps cover the Picard sheaf pointwise.
    20	
    21	## Main declarations
    22

/-- **The strict drop at a point, abstract window form**: for an effective `D'` of degree
`g` under an embedding level `N` with exact normalization windows (`hNnorm`) and budget
`2g ≤ deg N`, adding any closed point strictly drops `h⁰(𝒪(N − D'))`: when `deg x ≤ g`
both normalization windows are exact and the drop is `deg x ≥ 1`; when `deg x > g` the
raw DD-0 section bound undercuts the window value.  The abstract-`N` transcription of
P-fib's `h0_normalization_sub_single_lt` (consumed fibrewise by DDR-8, where `N` is the
base-field transport of the ledger window `M·F`). -/
lemma h0_window_sub_single_lt (n : ℕ) {gamma : ℕ} {hgamma : gamma ≤ n}
    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1)
    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (gamma : ℤ))
    (N : Y.CurveDivisor)
    (hNnorm : ∀ D' : Y.CurveDivisor, CurveDivisor.deg K D' ≤ 2 * (n : ℤ) →
      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D')) 1))
    (hNdeg : 2 * (n : ℤ) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K N)
    (D' : Y.CurveDivisor) (hdeg : CurveDivisor.deg K D' = (n : ℤ))
    {x : Y} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint Y) :
    Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D' - CurveDivisor.single hx 1))
      < Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D')) := by
  have hdx : 0 < Y.residueDeg K x := Scheme.residueDeg_pos hx
  have hdxz : (1 : ℤ) ≤ (Y.residueDeg K x : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hdx
  have hdegsingle : CurveDivisor.deg K (CurveDivisor.single hx 1)
      = 1 * (Y.residueDeg K x : ℤ) := CurveDivisor.deg_single K ⟨x, hx⟩ 1
  have hnn : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (n : ℤ) := Int.natCast_nonneg n
  have hn2 : CurveDivisor.deg K D' ≤ 2 * (n : ℤ) := by omega
  have hbig : (Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D')) : ℤ)
      = CurveDivisor.deg K N - CurveDivisor.deg K D'
        + Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) := by
    rw [h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one _ (hNnorm D' hn2),
      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' K]
  rw [hχ, hdeg] at hbig
  have hsplit : N - D' - CurveDivisor.single hx 1
      = N - (D' + CurveDivisor.single hx 1) := by
    abel
  have hdegD'x : CurveDivisor.deg K (D' + CurveDivisor.single hx 1)
      = (n : ℤ) + (Y.residueDeg K x : ℤ) := by
    rw [CurveDivisor.deg_add, hdeg, hdegsingle]
    ring
  by_cases hd : (Y.residueDeg K x : ℤ) ≤ (n : ℤ)
  · -- small residue degree: both windows are exact
    have hn2' : CurveDivisor.deg K (D' + CurveDivisor.single hx 1) ≤ 2 * (n : ℤ) := by
      omega
    have hsmall : (Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K
          (N - (D' + CurveDivisor.single hx 1))) : ℤ)
        = CurveDivisor.deg K N
            - CurveDivisor.deg K (D' + CurveDivisor.single hx 1)
          + Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) := by
      rw [h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one _ (hNnorm _ hn2'),
        Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' K]
    rw [hχ, hdegD'x] at hsmall
    rw [hsplit]
    omega
  · -- large residue degree: the section bound undercuts the window
    have hsec := h0_divisorSheaf_le_max_of_h0_one K hO
      (N - D' - CurveDivisor.single hx 1)
    have hdegsub : CurveDivisor.deg K (N - D' - CurveDivisor.single hx 1)
        = CurveDivisor.deg K N - (n : ℤ) - (Y.residueDeg K x : ℤ) := by
      rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' K, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' K, hdeg,
        hdegsingle]
      ring
    rw [hdegsub] at hsec
    rcases le_max_iff.mp hsec with h0le | hvle
    · omega
    · omega
